description: Scan was obtained at an outside institution and digitized from printed film, thus the lack of stacks and somewhat degraded image quality.  MRI demonstrates a right temporal lobe mass which is isointense to brain on T1, hyperintense on T2 and FLAIR, has no restricted diffusion or calcification. A solid nodule vividly enhances.
